sources.title: The hippocampus as a spatial map. Preliminary evidence from unit activity in the freely-moving rat
sources.notes: Classic discovery of place cells; foundational evidence for cognitive map in hippocampus

sources.authors: Hafting T, Fyhn M, Molden S, Moser MB, Moser EI
sources.title: Microstructure of a spatial map in the entorhinal cortex
sources.notes: Nobel Prize-winning discovery of grid cells in MEC; hexagonal firing pattern

sources.authors: Sargolini F, Fyhn M, Hafting T, McNaughton BL, Witter MP, Moser MB, Moser EI
sources.title: Conjunctive representation of position, direction, and velocity in entorhinal cortex
sources.notes: Discovery of conjunctive cells encoding grid position + head direction + speed; layer II vs deep layer organization

sources.authors: McNaughton BL, Battaglia FP, Jensen O, Moser EI, Moser MB
sources.title: Path integration and the neural basis of the 'cognitive map'
sources.notes: Continuous attractor network model of path integration; multi-module grid-to-place cell transformation theory

sources.title: Phase relationship between hippocampal place units and the EEG theta rhythm
sources.notes: Classic discovery of theta phase precession; place cell firing systematically advances in phase during field traversal

sources.authors: Stensola H, Stensola T, Solstad T, Frøland K, Moser MB, Moser EI
sources.title: The entorhinal grid map is discretized
sources.notes: 186 grid cells recorded; 4-7 discrete modules with scale ratio ~√2; modules respond independently to environmental geometry changes

sources.title: Memory, navigation and theta rhythm in the hippocampal-entorhinal system
sources.notes: Comprehensive review of memory-navigation link; theta oscillation framework; path integration; allocentric vs egocentric navigation; 6 open questions

sources.authors: Zhang SJ, Ye J, Couey JJ, Witter M, Moser EI, Moser MB
sources.title: Functional connectivity of the entorhinal-hippocampal space circuit
sources.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B
sources.notes: Optogenetics: activating MEC layer II (grid cells) induces place-selective firing in hippocampus; grid cells are the most abundant hippocampus-projecting spatial cell type

sources.authors: Rowland DC, Roudi Y, Moser MB, Moser EI
sources.title: Ten Years of Grid Cells
sources.notes: Comprehensive 10-year review; comparison of CAN vs OI models for grid generation; still unresolved

sources.authors: Bellmund JLS, Deuker L, Navarro Schröder T, Doeller CF
sources.title: Grid-cell representations in mental simulation
sources.notes: Human fMRI: hexagonal (60°) periodic pattern in posterior MEC during mental simulation without physical movement; key evidence for grid code operating independent of actual movement

sources.authors: Moser EI, Moser MB, McNaughton BL
sources.title: Spatial representation in the hippocampal formation: a history
sources.notes: Historical review from place cells through head direction cells to grid cells to border cells; self-motion integration concepts

sources.authors: Nau M, Navarro Schröder T, Bellmund JLS, Doeller CF
sources.title: Hexadirectional coding of visual space in human entorhinal cortex
sources.notes: Human fMRI: 6-fold rotationally symmetric signal in EC during visual gaze direction tracking; grid code extends to visual space

sources.authors: Qu Y, Ou J, Pang L, Wu S, Luo Y, Behrens T, Liu Y
sources.title: Development of non-spatial grid-like neural codes tracks inference and intelligence
sources.notes: 203 participants aged 8-25: non-spatial grid-like codes in EC mature with age and predict fluid intelligence; grid code maturation underlies abstract reasoning development

sources.authors: Kransberg J, Sjøli Bråthen AC, Falch ES, et al.
sources.title: Failure to detect entorhinal grid-like signals in a passive navigation human fMRI study
sources.notes: Pre-registered null result: no grid-like signal in passive navigation; conflicts with prior fMRI evidence; suggests active movement is necessary condition
